notes.title: Demo Patch #6 Hotfix
notes.notes: Tooltips were being destroyed on inventory updates, and shouldn't be any longer

notes.title: Demo Patch #6
notes.notes:
Volume refreshes more frequently on the main screen

Commits and upgrades have been redone and hopefully fixes the negative major/minor/patches bug

Processes sometimes had bad weights/volumes

Fleet assembly now properly disables itself when there is no room in either the fleet or storage for the new ship

Fleet assembly also can send the new ship to storage if fleet is full but storage is not

Ore B is now visible/usable

All items have their economic value shown, and this the total is reflected in the upgrades screen for more clarity on how upgrade commits get earned

notes.title: Demo Patch #5
notes.notes:
Abandoning battles due to deadlock or any reason is now possible. Upon abandoning, any active ships are considered lost

Process Priorities now has a simple copy/paste system to rapidly change process priorities

Smelting maximum time tool tip was updated to reflect its actual changes, along with changes in calculations to give it an actual change in resource return rate

Redeploys and their associated colors have been changed to conform to the rest of the game

Process upgrades now have a 5x and 10x multiplier at the bottom to save your fingers from clicking too much

Mining minimum time has been updated to reflect what it says in the tooltip

notes.title: Demo Patch #4
notes.notes:
Transfer crash bug fixed

Process upgrade tool tips now show the current level

Ships can now be destroyed in the fleet menu

Ship levels are now more prominently displayed in the fleet menu

Two new help files have been added to explain combat mechanics a bit better'

"Collect Equipment" has been renamed to "Collect one" in the manufacturing tab

notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.notes:
"Resets" have been changed to having the same language as "redeploy"

Help file colors were inconsistent and needed standardization

Two new help files on site quality and how mining quality and stability work

Neural network output nodes (the far right nodes) now show their bonuses when hovered and bonuses have been rolled

Minor achievement fixes - loaded/unloading distances have been adjusted and fixed and your volume maxes should have a multiplier now

Crafting menu shows current inventory of proposed crafting cost

notes.title: Demo Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,



One of the most consistent pieces of feedback we've received is how challenging it is to get the game to run on different screens, and by extension, the readability of the text. Given it's almost an entirely text driven game, it felt appropriate to make the following changes:


Display resolution has been added to the options menu. It has 4 of the most popular resolutions. Keep in mind the game assets themselves will be upscaled or downscaled.

Display mode has been added to the options menu. It has the basic options such as Windowed, Maximized, Full Screen, and Exclusive Full Screen

Two new fonts have been added, going off of other titles' choices

Fonts now have a size setting. Unfortunately this did require changing all text in the game, so there might be too much uniformity in font size moving forward 

The options menu has had a nice little revamp to go with these new options



We're going back to a bug fixing and QoL schedule after this, though if any problems arise, please let us known on our discord!

Sorry, and thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.notes:
Fixed a null reference error for processes on loading a save game
 Updated the crafting costs for additives/patterns to be monotonic
 Shields now start with a 5 second delay in regen, lowerable with the "seconds to shield regen" modifier
 Process upgrades now properly disable themselves if they're not yet unlocked for that process
 Redeploy upgrades always cost at least one commit, whether it is major, minor, or patch
 Fixed a bug with changing craft bases that had leftover costs from previously selected additives/patterns
